lead: `var` and a written type are two different declarations, and `var T $x = …` is neither.
body: `var $x = …` infers; a declared type is `T $x = …;` with no `var` at all, so `var Core\Regex\Pattern $p = …` is four diagnostics (`E0101` three times, then `E0301` for a name never declared), none of which says "drop the `var`". The inferring spelling is the one every case reaches for, so the typed one looks like it should take a keyword too.
